_comment: Cookie Run OvenBreak (com.devsisters.crg) run-grind with Multi-Buy Double Coins. All coords verified live @1920x1080. Loop: home->Play->boost_shop->probe_dc_owned(skip buy if Double Coins banner already up)->buy_boost->Multi->picker->Multi-Buy(until Double Coins banner)->Play->run->boost_shop.

home._note: Main menu (Episode banner + leaderboard + Play!). Entry point of every loop. home_marker (Episode banner, top-left) still matches even when a modal dialog covers Play!, so DON'T tap Play here — first clear any 'Send a free Life?' dialog (a stray relay/jump tap can hit a leaderboard friend row and open it, blocking Play!) via probe_sendlife, which then taps Play in play_home.

probe_sendlife._note: A 'Send <friend> a free Life? (+N Gift Points)' dialog can pop over home when a stray in-run tap lands on a leaderboard friend row. It's a MODAL that blocks Play!, but home_marker still matches behind it. Tap Cancel (727,688 — gray, left) to dismiss; NEVER Confirm (1189,687 — green) since we don't want to burn gift interactions. Detected by the unique 'Gift Points' text. Absent -> Play! is clear, go tap it.

play_home._note: Play! is unobstructed now — tap it (1431,963) to open the boost shop and start a fresh buy loop.

boost_shop._note: boost shop open. BEFORE buying anything, route through probe_dc_owned: if the Double Coins banner is already up (boost equipped from a previous multi-buy — e.g. bot restarted after a roll landed but before the run consumed it), buying again just burns coins. Only when the banner is absent do we proceed to buy_boost.

probe_dc_owned._note: COIN GUARD: Multi-Buy must fire ONLY when Double Coins is NOT already equipped. doublecoins_banner.png (same template start_run uses) shows on the boost-shop right panel whenever the boost is active. Present -> skip the whole buy flow, go straight to the Play gate. Absent -> buy_boost opens the Multi picker as before.

buy_boost._note: No Double Coins equipped (probe_dc_owned confirmed banner absent). Tap the Random Boost gift box cell to make the right panel show Random Boost + Multi, then open the Multi picker.

picker._note: Pick desired Boosts popup. Double Coins stays pre-ticked by default — DO NOT tap it (the row is a toggle; tapping un-ticks it). Tap Multi-Buy ONCE — the game then AUTO-ROLLS by itself, repeatedly, until the ticked boost (Double Coins) lands, then stops on its own. A 'Stop'/progress animation plays the whole time. We must NOT tap Stop or anything else during it, and must NOT re-open Multi/re-buy — the game is already rolling. Hand off to wait_roll to sit still until the roll UI is gone.

wait_roll._note: The game's self-rolling multi-buy is in progress (multibuy_marker / Stop UI still on screen). Do NOTHING — no taps — just wait and self-loop so we never tap Stop and never re-buy. The game keeps rolling until Double Coins lands, then the roll UI disappears. Marker absent -> roll finished -> go read the banner. timeout_ms is generous because several rolls can chain for many seconds; on timeout fall through to start_run anyway (nocoins/other handling downstream).

check_boost_result._note: The game's auto-roll finished and the picker closed back to the boost shop. Check for 'Not enough Coins!' first (balance ran dry mid-roll) -> cancel. Otherwise read the banner in start_run. We DO NOT re-roll here — the game already rolled to completion; start_run just Plays with whatever landed.

insufficient_coins._note: SAFETY: 'Not enough Coins!' popup (auto-buy ran the balance dry). Tap Cancel (770,685) — NEVER Confirm (1150,685), which spends gems. Then Play! with whatever boost we have (or none).

force_play._note: Coins exhausted — stop chasing Double Coins, Play! with whatever boost we have. Still route through check_heart so we don't try to run on empty hearts.

start_run._note: The game's auto-roll already stopped on Double Coins (or ran the wallet dry). We do NOT re-roll here — one Multi-Buy tap kicks off the whole self-rolling sequence, so re-opening the picker would double-buy and can tap Stop mid-roll. Either way (Double Coins banner present or not) go through check_heart, which is the single gate before every Play — it blocks running when hearts are empty and NEVER gem-refills.

check_heart._note: SINGLE Play gate, reached from probe_dc_owned/start_run/force_play (all BOOST-SHOP context, Play at 1365,931). heart_empty.png = separator '|' + FIRST (leftmost) heart gray, cropped live at 0 hearts @1920x1080 — hearts deplete right-to-left, so the leftmost heart is gray ONLY at 0 hearts; the '|' anchor pins the match to slot 1 (gray hearts in other slots can't false-positive). CV verified: 0 hearts score=1.000; 1-3 hearts score=0.749-0.762 (under 0.82 threshold — thinner margin than other templates, don't raise match_threshold above ~0.9 without re-checking this one). Present -> hearts exhausted -> do NOT play; wait 30s and self-loop until a heart regenerates (timeout_ms must exceed the ~10-20 min regen: 25 min). HARD RULE: never buy hearts with gems/coins (the green heart 'Buy' button in the boost shop is off-limits — do not add a tap for it). Absent -> >=1 heart -> tap Play, start the run.

running._note: In-run (auto-play). Each poll we (1) JUMP with a human touch — a random point inside the Jump zone (left, ~238,940), ~35% of the time a quick double-jump — to clear obstacles frequently and look human, and (2) tap the Cookie Relay Boost icon that appears mid-screen (~960,540) to swap in the relay cookie (the 'วิ่งผลัด' the last build missed). Jump zone and relay icon don't overlap, so both fire safely every cycle. Run ends -> Result popup.

check_shop_after_run._note: Result popup not up yet — either still running, home is back, or we entered mid-boost_shop. Try home; on timeout fall through to boost_shop so a wrong entry point self-recovers instead of spinning forever.

probe_boostshop._note: Recovery probe: are we actually sitting in the boost shop (e.g. process started there, or run ended straight into shop)? If so, resume the buy loop; else check for a level-up popup.

probe_congrats._note: Level-up 'Congratulations!' popup (free reward, e.g. Treasure Ticket) appears over home after enough XP. Confirm (956,846) collects it — this Confirm is safe/free, unlike the nocoins Confirm. Then back to waiting.

probe_levelup._note: A separate 'Level Up' popup (gems/coins/score-bonus reward, distinct screen from the Congratulations ticket popup) can also appear after a run. Confirm (959,969) is safe/free — collects the reward.

probe_rankingrewards._note: SAFETY NET: a stray in-run relay tap (~960,540) can hit the leaderboard and open the gold 'Ranking Rewards' season-reward popup over home, which the probe chain otherwise can't clear (home_marker fails behind it) -> loop spins to max_cycles. Detected by the gold 'Ranking Rewards' title ribbon. Tap its single X (1672,135 — CV verified) to close; free/safe, no currency. Then back to home.

probe_giftdraw._note: SAFETY NET: 'Gift Draw' popup (100 Gift Points -> free gift box) can appear over home, e.g. after collecting enough points from daily login/send-life/invite. Detected by the teal 'Gift Draw' banner. Tap the X close (1685,170 — CV verified on the banner crop) rather than Draw, since we don't want to auto-spend/auto-consume the gift draw as part of the farm loop. Then back to home.

probe_friendinfo._note: SAFETY NET: a stray tap can occasionally land on a leaderboard row and open a 'Friend's Info/Cookie/Treasure' popup family — all share the same teal 'Friend's ___' ribbon, detected by matching just the word 'Friend's' (generic X-corner crops kept false-positiving on unrelated popups, e.g. the Event Rewards screen, since round X-close buttons look alike everywhere). Can stack 2 layers: an inner light-gray X (1552,117, closes the top Cookie/Treasure layer) and an outer dark-gray X (1633,107, closes the underlying Info layer). CV verified both centers @1920x1080 — the old 1651,105 landed ~18px RIGHT of the outer X (off the button), so taps did nothing and this state spun forever. Tap BOTH X's each pass, then self-loop until the ribbon is gone (peels one layer per pass regardless of how many are stacked).

run_result._note: Result popup after a run. Tap OK (702,940) — NOT 'Show Off' (blue, opens social share). After OK a Mystery Box popup sometimes appears -> mystery_box handles it.

mystery_box._note: After Result-OK we either land on home, or a 'Mystery Box' screen blocks it (only on runs whose Result showed a box icon). Discriminate by the HOME marker: home present -> done. Home absent -> detect the box screen explicitly in mystery_box_reveal (tapping the closed box opens it into a reward reveal with a teal Confirm).

mystery_box_reveal._note: Mystery Box reward reveal can show MULTIPLE ingredients (B, C, ...) — one Confirm tap only advances to the next item, it does not always close the screen. Self-loop: keep tapping Confirm (959,960) and re-checking THIS SAME state as long as the 'Mystery Box' title banner is still up. Only fall through to mystery_box_recheck once the title is confirmed gone.

mystery_box_recheck._note: After collecting the box: home back -> continue; still not home -> hand off to the probe chain (running -> check_shop -> probes) which self-recovers.
